retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: the European Parliament election of 18 June 1989, the second in Portugal, for the same twenty-four seats as in 1987. The atlas keeps the first exercise of an institution and the ballot at which it became a cycle, and retracts the routine repetitions after them; the second European election is one. The only link available is the constitutional one the earlier records already carry. Revisit if a consequence is written.
